svg.metadata: THESIS: Field evidence becomes accountable public work; refuse generic card dashboards and ornamental cinematic effects. OWN-WORLD: Civic Aperture morning/night palette, open/ruled surfaces, one Field Aperture per viewport, Signal Cut, Archivo + Source Sans 3 + IBM Plex Mono. STORY: Residents see evidence, location, status, next event, and a thumb-visible report action; the shared library keeps both portals consistent. FIRST VIEWPORT: Resident evidence leads, then active record/location, authored lifecycle, report action, and five stable destinations. Foundations/library make light/dark parity and recovery explicit. FORM: Operate; user-pinned Civic Aperture v0.2; seed key not applicable because the user explicitly approved the generated direction. FINISH: unreviewed and undocumented is unfinished; this build ends with the finish review, the verdict, DESIGN.md, and every shipping raster carrying its provenance.

This is a synthetic design-study crop derived from docs/ui-ux-audit/assets/concept-v2-resident-light-dark.png, with the generation recipe recorded at docs/ui-ux-audit/assets/concept-v2-imagegen-prompts.md, and it must be replaced by governed resident evidence before production.
svg.title: PULSO resident home — Dark mode
svg.desc: Mobile resident dashboard showing a synthetic sample flooded-street report, coordinate record, map, five-stage response lifecycle, report action, and bottom navigation.

g.text: Next: Crew confirms arrival on site
